project_type: Next.js 16 App Router + React 19 + TypeScript portfolio site, statically exported to GitHub Pages under base path /frankfabric/. Tailwind CSS 3. Four client-only 3D scenes via three ^0.186 + @react-three/fiber ^9.7 + @react-three/drei ^10.7 + @pixiv/three-vrm ^3.5.
build_system: npm + Next.js. Node v22.23.2 (via nvm at /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin; `node`/`npm` are on PATH under a login shell but the non-login execute_bash shell may need the nvm path — use `npm` after confirming it resolves, or invoke via the nvm bin path).
test_framework: No unit test framework. Verification is `npm run lint` + `npm run build` (static export) plus the measure-load.mjs headless-Chrome harness for byte + screenshot evidence. NOTE: the tireshop reference's `npm run check` / 260 tests / dist wording does NOT apply to frankfabric — its equivalent is lint + a clean static-export build; never commit build output.
build_command: npm run build   (Next.js static export into out/; must succeed and prerender all 5 pages: /, /projects/chef-chatbot, /projects/coach-trainer, /projects/digital-wardrobe, /projects/virtual-pet)
test_command: npm run lint   (must be clean EXCEPT one pre-existing, EXPECTED @next/next/no-page-custom-font warning in app/layout.tsx; 0 errors otherwise)
verification_instructions: 1) npm install. 2) npm run lint (only the expected font warning allowed). 3) npm run build (static export succeeds, all 5 pages prerender). 4) Reuse scripts/measure-load.mjs for fixed-camera screenshots + cold-load bytes; a frame-time capture harness must be ADDED (measure-load.mjs measures bytes+screenshot only, NOT frame time). 5) Chrome for Testing is at /usr/local/bin/chrome (playwright-core launches it with --use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader --ignore-gpu-blocklist --no-sandbox; software rasterizer). Viewport 1280x900, dpr 1. State machine+browser in every measurement doc.
snapshot_or_generated_files: out/ (static export, gitignored, NEVER commit). docs/perf/ holds WS1 evidence (after-*.{json,png}, AFTER.md, BASELINE.md, DIFF.md) - do NOT overwrite it. WS2 visual evidence goes under docs/visual/. .next/, node_modules/, out/, assets-src/ are all gitignored and must never be committed.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/frankfabric; ensure npm resolves (nvm node v22.23.2); npm install. Do NOT re-clone. Work on branch visual/lighting-quality (already created off merged main; commit there, do NOT push).
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET (npm install works; Chrome already present, no download needed). GPU is a SOFTWARE rasterizer (SwiftShader) in headless Chrome, so absolute FPS is not representative of real hardware - report RELATIVE frame time (Fast before vs after must show NO regression; also report High). Measurements are deterministic-ish but note the software-GL caveat in the docs.
contribution_requirements: Every public/ URL MUST route through lib/asset.ts asset() (base path). Anything touching WebGL/DOM stays behind next/dynamic { ssr:false } (already true for all four scene wrappers). Preserve WS1 wins: no eager preloading, don't statically re-pull the heavy three chunk into a page (keep OPTIONS in components/wardrobe/wardrobeOptions.ts, the zero-three module), keep SceneLoader/useProgress fallback. ASK BEFORE ADDING A DEPENDENCY - drei ^10 already ships ContactShadows, SoftShadows, AccumulativeShadows, Environment, Lightformer, BakeShadows; use those. If an env map/HDRI or texture is added, route it through asset() and mind the WS1 cold-load byte budget (prefer small/procedural), note byte delta.
key_patterns: There is NO shared lighting rig today - each Canvas lights itself in JSX (ambientLight + 1-2 directionalLight + hemisphereLight) and sets gl.toneMapping in onCreated. Three scenes use THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping (coach, chef, pet, wardrobe all currently ACESFilmic). ContactShadows is already present in ALL FOUR scenes (coach opacity .3, wardrobe .4, chef .28, pet .32) - so 'contact shadows so nothing floats' is partially done; the WS2 work is to make lighting a proper key/fill/bounce rig, soften shadow edges, add ground/backdrop material depth, and gate heavier effects behind a shared High/Fast quality concept. Shadow maps are 1024x1024 today (High path can go higher). There is NO quality selector anywhere in frankfabric yet - WS2 must ADD exactly ONE shared quality concept used across all four scenes.
tone_mapping_facts: CONSTRAINT #2 (measurement-gated): do NOT change any scene's tone-map operator/exposure without a per-scene before/after screenshot proving it fixes (not causes) skin/face highlight blow-out. Tireshop's proven fix for skin clipping under strong lights is THREE.NeutralToneMapping @ exposure 1.0 (ACESFilmic rolled VRM skin highlights to white). The analogous skin-bearing avatars in frankfabric are the WARDROBE (real VRM/MToon-ish, drophunter body.vrm) and the CHEF. IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY the coder must know: the briefing calls the chef a VRM, but the CODE (components/chef/ChefScene.tsx + README) shows the chef is a Swedish Chef *FBX* whose material is replaced with a matte MeshStandardMaterial (NOT MToon/VRM). It still bears skin/face texture, so the no-blow-out check applies, but the MToon-specific reasoning is wardrobe-only. Surface this discrepancy in the WS2 report; it is not a blocker.
do_not_break: 1) Do NOT alter 3D pose/transform constants logic depends on (AIM_HEIGHT, AIM_MODEL_FRACTION, CAMERA_DISTANCE, MODEL_SCALE/TARGET_HEIGHT, gesture/motion transforms, pet motion transforms). Lighting/material work must not touch these; if framing looks off, measure and report, don't nudge. 2) Tone mapping measurement-gated (above). 3) VRM skin/hair/brow tint constants + material.color tint pipeline in lib/vrm/* are FINAL - light around them, don't change tint colors or tint code. 4) Leave recently-fixed chat/UI layout alone. 5) lib/data.ts + data/*.json are the only content source; don't hard-code content in components.
directory_structure: app/ (App Router pages incl. app/projects/{chef-chatbot,coach-trainer,digital-wardrobe,virtual-pet}/page.tsx); components/ (scene + chatbot components grouped by feature: coach/, chef/, pet/, wardrobe/, plus WardrobeBuilder.tsx and three/SceneLoader.tsx); lib/ (asset.ts, data.ts, vrm/, chef/, coach/, pet/); public/ (models, animations, images, wardrobe thumbnails - all served via asset()); scripts/ (measure-load.mjs harness + one-time asset scripts); docs/perf/ (WS1 evidence). tireshop reference is READ-ONLY at /projects/sandbox/tireshop.
